safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of neck stiffness in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag feature for meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage in an acute severe headache; omitting a documented denial reduces the reliability of the safety screen in the record. This could lead to unnecessary escalation or, conversely, less confidence in ruling out dangerous causes on review.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No fever denial is not captured in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is another important red-flag associated with infectious etiologies (e.g., meningitis/encephalitis) in headache; omission of a fever denial weakens documentation of appropriate red-flag assessment. The immediate clinical impact is limited but could affect subsequent triage or re-assessment.
